office.import_title: Convert local Office documents to PDF
office.new_copy: The original stays unchanged. A separate file is created; existing files are never overwritten.
office.word_limits: Word reflows visible, unrotated, single-column text into 11 pt paragraphs. Original fonts, spacing, page breaks, semantic tables and graphics are not reconstructed. Complex pages, forms, clipping and bidirectional text are refused.
office.excel_limits: Excel maps visible text objects into rows and inferred columns, one sheet per PDF page. Every value is a literal string. Formulas, number types, merged cells, original styling and semantic tables are not reconstructed. Ambiguous or complex pages are refused.
office.powerpoint_limits: PowerPoint contains one 150 dpi PNG per PDF page. Text, tables and vectors are not editable. Mixed page sizes are fitted with margins. Maximum 8 million pixels per page.
office.export_limits: Exports support 1–128 pages and packages up to 128 MiB. Copy restrictions apply. Only PowerPoint preserves the visible page as an image; Word and Excel cannot guarantee the original layout. PDF signatures and encryption are not retained.
office.detected: Installed LibreOffice detected. Version 26.2 or 26.8 is checked before conversion.
office.unavailable: Local conversion is unavailable. Install a supported LibreOffice 26.2 or 26.8 separately, then reopen this dialog. SuniPDF does not download or install converters.
office.import_limits: Local, isolated processing: 1–128 macro-free DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/ODT/ODS/ODP files, 64 MiB per input, 120 seconds per conversion, 256 MiB per PDF. Macros, formulas, active fields, external links and embedded objects are refused. Unsupported fonts or layout may differ; review each result.
office.profile_limits: Standard: JPEG quality 90, images reduced to 150 dpi. Print: lossless images with no reduction. The selected profile is saved. Neither profile claims PDF/A or PDF/UA compliance.

certificate.summary.failed: Verification failed for one or more signatures.
certificate.summary.trusted: Signature integrity and signer identity verified.
certificate.summary.integrity_only: Signature integrity verified; signer identity is not fully trusted.
certificate.declared_by_signer: Declared by the signer — not a verification result
review.saved_files: Read-only analysis of selected saved files. Save current edits first. Nothing is uploaded; no folder is crawled and no index is saved.
review.limits: Up to 64 files, 64 MiB per file and 250,000 extracted characters per page. Protected files are reported separately. Search: 10,000 pages / 2,000 matching pages per run.
review.compare_limits: Align physical pages from these starting pages; inserted pages are not detected automatically. Preview: 768 pixels, channel tolerance 16/255. No OCR, semantic comparison, signature, hidden-data or conformance validation. No observed difference does not prove identical PDFs.
review.partial: Partial results — cancelled, limited or failed inputs remain unanalysed
review.no_matches: No matches in the analysed text. Image-only pages require OCR first.
review.comparison_summary: {scanned}/{total} aligned page pairs analysed; {changed} pairs have observed differences.
review.geometry_changed: Page size or page presence differs
review.no_text: Some page pairs have no extractable text. Only their preview and page geometry can be compared; OCR is not automatic.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.scope: Choose a command, then assign a Ctrl shortcut. Escape cancels; Save applies all changes. Navigation, clipboard and system keys remain reserved.
shortcuts.syntax: Use Ctrl, optional Shift, and one letter, digit, F2–F12, Tab, Delete, Plus, Equals, Minus, OpenBracket or CloseBracket.
shortcuts.reserved: This shortcut is reserved for text editing or Windows.
shortcuts.invalid: Invalid stored shortcuts. Restore defaults before saving; the app currently uses defaults.
shortcuts.save_failed: Preferences could not be saved. Your active shortcuts have not changed.
watermark.image_scope: Foreground image, fitted inside the margins. Existing transparency is retained. Undo removes the whole batch.
headers.title: Headers and footers
headers.scope: Six single-line zones, one third of page width each. Overflow is refused. One Undo removes the entire operation.
